title: Tool offer
description: The tools the host offers a run, as the session's two members: the runtime's tools (session.tools: McpTool, exactly as tools/list served them, filtered to this session's allow-list, reached only through callTool and the host's gate) and the host's own tools (session.hostTools: HostTool, run by the host on the adapter's behalf, answered in the shape a runtime answer takes). An adapter offers the model exactly these, under their served schemas (servedSchema: a tool served without an input schema ends the session; the Gemini family alone is shown the schema less a closed list of keywords, with a guardrail narrowed event per tool that lost one). The host also adds its own context tools (list_context, read_context, read and, in a conversation, update_plan and request_budget_increase), whose names an offered tool may not take. Read from web/src/assistant/engine.ts (McpTool, HostTool) and context/session.ts (contextualSession). Open: the session is an in-process value with no reader, and the runtime's answer is passed through as served.

tools.description: The runtime's tools (session.tools), each named within the ceiling.

hostTools.description: The host's tools (session.hostTools), the context tools the boundary adds included.

runtimeTool.description: A runtime tool (McpTool). No effect class is carried: the host decides what is read-only by name (runtimeToolContextPolicy and the read list in context/managed.ts).

inputSchema.description: The runtime's own JSON Schema for the arguments, passed through untouched.

hostTool.description: A host tool's declaration (HostTool, without its execute function, which never crosses). Its schema is the host's, written in the subset every family's wire carries.

effect.description: Host-declared effect, never supplied by model arguments.

interaction.description: A tool that pauses the run for the person (question: ask_user) or for the host's coordinator (delegation: delegate_tasks). The adapter emits user_question or delegation_requested, pauses, and returns no answer of its own.

delegation.description: The read-only capability this tool offers to a delegated child; absent means parent-only.

contextPolicy.description: Host-declared context retention (ContextToolPolicy), independent of topic, provider and action permission. immutable: the same arguments return the same value for this execution, so a read may be cached. reference: prefer this material in the bounded working summary.

presentation.description: Host-owned presentation, frozen when the tool is offered.

agentWireTool.description: A tool as the codex engine offers it on the agent wire (codexbridge.Tool in the start frame's request): an alias name desk_runtime_N or desk_host_N, the real name prefixed to the description, and the served schema. Closed: the Desk server decodes the start frame with unknown members refused; a request carries at most 128 tools.

inputSchema.description: The served schema, which the Desk server requires to be a JSON object whose type is object, at most 64 KiB (65536 bytes) as JSON text; a description is at most 8192 bytes, and all tools' schemas and descriptions together at most 1 MiB (codexbridge threadParams).

runtimeCeiling.description: The runtime tools any session may be allowed (ASSISTANT_TOOLS). A session's allow-list is a subset; the gate refuses a call outside it on the wire.

reservedName.description: Names the host keeps for its own context tools; an offered tool that takes one ends the session.
